authority: docs/derivations/S10-spec.md section 8.1 (as amended by section 15 A2-3); S10.A40-A42
property_package: idaes.models.properties.activity_coeff_models.activity_coeff_prop_pack (ActivityCoeffParameterData / ActivityCoeffStateBlockData subclassed for the components, the parameters and the S10 P^sat at its three sites)

mapping.liquid_coefficient_units: J/kmol/K^(k+1), converted by the package to J/mol

application_notes: Standalone state block (FlowsheetBlock, steady state; build_state_block([0], defined_state=True, has_phase_equilibrium=True)): the TP flash at the registered (z, T, P) with flow_mol = 1 mol/s; enth_mol_phase, temperature_bubble, temperature_dew, pressure_sat_comp and fug_phase_comp are constructed before eps is set and before the initializer runs.
eps_1 = eps_2 = the rung is set on the state block before the initializer runs, so that the initializer and the final solve see the same equations (T06 precedent).

The initializer is the package's ActivityCoeffStateBlock.initialize() with no arguments; its Ipopt comes from idaes.core.solvers.get_solver(), with idaes.cfg.ipopt.options.linear_solver set to the attempt's linear solver and its other options IDAES defaults.
ipopt_log_sha256 is the hash of the log file as written; it names Pyomo's temporary .nl file and carries timings, so it differs from run to run while every value does not.
Converged = Pyomo optimal termination and Ipopt's 'EXIT: Optimal Solution Found.' (Solved To Acceptable Level is not counted).
The I-state composition is z = n / sum(n), in the order (CH3OH, C2H5OH, H2O); a zero component stays in the model with z_i = 0 (the registered state).

readbacks.method: calculate_variable_from_constraint on each property constraint, phase compositions = x, temperature = _temperature_equilibrium = temperature_bubble = temperature_dew = T (fixed)

registered.initializer: the package's own state-block initialize() from the registered state, no per-state tuning
registered.selection: the first rung at which every I-state ends optimal is used for all of them; a state optimal at no rung is NOT_COMPARABLE
